tooltip.en: Angle from 0 to 180; out-of-range values are clamped. 50 Hz servo (SG90, MG90S, MG996R). Supply external 5 V and connect the grounds. Experimental MicroPython.

globals:
def servos_mover(servo, angulo):
    angulo = max(0, min(180, angulo))
    # Pulso de 0.5 ms (0°) a 2.5 ms (180°) cada 20 ms.
    servo.duty_ns(int(500000 + angulo * 2000000 / 180))
